content.user_title: Validate Agent Work with Quality Gates
content.value_statement: Complex agent tasks often fail when requirements, blockers, and evidence are unclear. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code structured gates for readiness, escalation, and completion checks.
actual_capabilities: Assess task complexity with a five-level scoring model.
Identify unanswered critical questions before implementation starts.
Classify work as pass, warning, or blocked based on clear thresholds.
Track failed attempts and recommend escalation after repeated failures.
Provide reusable templates for gate checks, requirements, and task breakdowns.
Require evidence such as passing tests or builds before completion.
limitations: It provides process guidance, not automated test execution.
It depends on the agent or user to fill templates accurately.
It does not replace product requirements or architecture review.
It may add overhead for very small or routine tasks.

use_cases.title: Plan Complex Feature Work
use_cases.description: Break a large feature into smaller tasks with dependencies, acceptance criteria, and gate decisions.

use_cases.title: Prevent Agent Drift
use_cases.description: Force an AI agent to pause when requirements are unclear, dependencies are missing, or attempts keep failing.

use_cases.title: Standardize Completion Evidence
use_cases.description: Create a repeatable checklist for tests, builds, assumptions, and proof before marking a task complete.

prompt_templates.title: Run a Basic Gate Check
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner prompt for a small task.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the quality-gates skill to assess this task before starting: [task]. List complexity, blockers, unanswered questions, and whether I can proceed.

prompt_templates.title: Validate Requirements
prompt_templates.scenario: Check whether a feature request is ready for implementation.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the requirements checklist to review this feature request: [request]. Identify missing functional, technical, error handling, and validation details.

prompt_templates.title: Handle a Blocked Task
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the stuck detection workflow. I have tried these approaches: [attempts]. Decide whether the task is blocked and draft the escalation summary.

prompt_templates.title: Design Gates for a Large Change
prompt_templates.prompt: Use quality gates to break this Level 4 or Level 5 task into subtasks: [task]. Define gate checks, dependencies, evidence, and completion criteria for each phase.

output_examples.input: Assess whether I should start building a new payment settings page.
output_examples.output: The skill returns a gate decision, complexity score, missing requirements, dependencies, and required evidence before implementation.

output_examples.input: I tried three fixes for a failing integration test and none worked.
output_examples.output: The skill recommends a blocked status, summarizes attempts, identifies the current blocker, and asks for targeted human guidance.

output_examples.input: Break down a large migration task into safer steps.
output_examples.output: The skill produces subtasks with complexity ratings, dependencies, acceptance criteria, and pass or blocked gate checks.

best_practices: Run a quick gate check before starting any task with unclear requirements.
Document assumptions whenever a gate returns warning instead of pass.
Require concrete evidence before marking implementation work complete.
anti_patterns: Do not bypass a blocked gate to make visible progress.
Do not keep retrying the same failed approach without documenting attempts.
Do not treat the templates as a substitute for real tests or user acceptance criteria.

faq.question: What does this skill do?
faq.answer: It helps agents decide whether a task is ready to start, needs caution, or is blocked.

faq.question: Does it run tests automatically?
faq.answer: No. It asks for evidence and templates, but the agent or user must run the relevant checks.

faq.question: When should I use it?
faq.answer: Use it before complex tasks, after repeated failures, or before declaring work complete.

faq.question: Can it help with unclear requirements?
faq.answer: Yes. It lists missing functional, technical, error handling, and validation requirements.

faq.question: Is it only for Claude Code?
faq.answer: No. The skill is compatible with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.

faq.question: Will it slow down simple tasks?
faq.answer: It can add process overhead, so use a lightweight check for small and routine work.
